title: Add a blocking CI check that rejects unpinned FROM lines and @latest installs
description: Add a job to .github/workflows/docker.yml, or a new workflow file under .github/workflows/, that runs on pull requests touching `**/Dockerfile*`. It fails when any `FROM` line lacks `@sha256:`, or when any `RUN` line installs a package with `@latest` or with no version. hadolint rules DL3006/DL3007 plus a grep step are sufficient. Pin every action used in the job by commit SHA. Mark the job as a required status check on main. Scope the check to deploy/aws/Dockerfile until the root Dockerfile is fixed under the initiative for fnd_01M2GH5AS0MM2F8MSFTDP36VV9, then widen it to all Dockerfiles.
acceptanceCriteria: A test PR that changes deploy/aws/Dockerfile back to `FROM node:24-alpine` fails the new job with a message naming the file and line
A test PR that reintroduces `npm install -g mongodb-mcp-server@latest` fails the same job
The job passes on main after tasks 1 and 2 are merged
Branch protection for main lists the job as a required status check

verificationMethod.description: Open two throwaway PRs against mongodb-mcp-server: one reverting line 2 to an undigested FROM, one reintroducing @latest on the npm install. Expected: both show the new check as failed and blocked from merge. Close both PRs unmerged and attach the check-run URLs as task evidence.

rootCause.description: No pipeline gate inspects Dockerfiles for mutable tags or floating package versions, which is how the unpinned AgentCore image reached the default branch unnoticed.
